pr_title: feat: Raise if `pivot` would introduce duplicate column names

issue_context.title: pivot may still introduce duplicate column names (in a different way!)
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

the duplicates never stop
```python
In [6]: df = pl.DataFrame({'a': [1,3,2], 'c': ['a', 'a', 'a'], 'd':[7,8,9]})

In [7]: df.pivot(index='a', columns='c', values='d')
Out[7]:
shape: (3, 2)
┌─────┬─────┐
│ a   ┆ a   │
│ --- ┆ --- │
│ i64 ┆ i64 │
╞═════╪═════╡
│ 1   ┆ 7   │
│ 3   ┆ 8   │
│ 2   ┆ 9   │
└─────┴─────┘
```

### Log output

_No response_

### Issue description

if `index` is a column with the same name as one of the values in the `columns` column

### Expected behavior

raise

comments: Any idea of a naming strategy here?

tidyr would just raise, and pandas doesn't consider duplicate column names to be a bug (!) (though pandas has an index anyway, so in this case it would just name the index `'a'`)

I'd suggest just raising

review_comments: This should be tagged `unsafe` as it doesn't check the invariant of `DataFrame`.

I can make a quick patch! For reference, the `new_no_checks` method has the following signature:

```
pub const fn new_no_checks(columns: Vec<Series>) -> DataFrame
```

Is this correct or should that also be tagged unsafe?

taken from 

https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/blob/32df09e57818861e0758a307883b8602179bd18d/crates/polars-core/src/frame/mod.rs#L264-L266
